source_independence: Readouts are public government representations; same joint statement and its translations are not independent witnesses. Chadha combines the same public texts with anonymized Indian interviews; repeated Stakeholder8 citations are not additional independent corroboration. No Chinese officials interviewed; no new interviews by this project.
